items.name: Thousand Yes
items.description: This book contains 500 pages, with the word "Yes" written repeatedly on both sides of every page. Many believe there is more to this book than what meets the eye, but no one has yet identified its true purpose. Holding the book gives an ominous, unsettling feeling, and staring into its pages for too long makes it seem as if the word itself begins to warp and shift. The only clue to its origin is the name of its author is a small note stating "One."

items.name: Scroll of Magic Missile
items.description:
A missile of magical energy darts forth from your fingertip and strikes its target, dealing 1d4+1 points of force damage.
The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment.
Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell.
For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile-two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of five missiles at 9th

items.name: Wand of Bless Weapon
items.description: This transmutation makes a weapon strike true against evil foes. The weapon is treated as having a +1 enhancement bonus for the purpose of bypassing the DR of evil creatures or striking evil incorporeal creatures (though the spell doesn't grant an actual enhancement bonus). The weapon also becomes good-aligned, which means it can bypass the DR of certain creatures. (This effect overrides and suppresses any other alignment the weapon might have.) Individual arrows or bolts can be transmuted, but

items.description:

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Leather armor is made up of multiple overlapping pieces of leather, boiled to increase their natural toughness and then deliberately stitched together. Although not as sturdy as metal armor, the flexibility it allows wearers makes it among the most widely used types of armor.

items.name: Chelish Blacksteel Katana
items.description:
The Chelish Blacksteel Katana is forged in the fires of the Nine Hells, bestowing it with a dark, ominous gleam. Its blade is sharp enough to cut through the moral fabric between worlds. Often wielded by ninja assassin devils of Cheliax, this katana is a feared symbol of the infernal powers of House Thrune. The hilt is wrapped in black leather, and infernal runes adorn the blade. The weapon is perfectly balanced for both swift slashes and precise thrusts.
Aura: faint transmutation
Caster Level:

items.name: Kit, Disguise
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 77, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 50 gp; Weight 8 lbs.
Category Tools
DescriptionThis kit contains tools like makeup and fake facial hair, and provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks. A disguise kit is exhausted after 10 uses.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: Silver Ore is one of the most sought-after ores, valued for its use in metallurgy and coinage. It is commonly made as an alloy with other metals and is the primary material for minting the most circulated type of coin. Unlike gold, which is often hoarded by the elite, silver circulates widely, fueling trade across vast empires. It can also be ground into fine dust for use in the making of mirrors and weaponry, as it is known to hunt down creatures of the night.

items.name: Plunderpress Merlot
items.description:
"Pressed with all the care and grace of a pirate’s boot—one sympathizes."
Plunderpress is the Shackles’ answer to a sailor’s thirst: rough, inconsistent, and just barely deserving of the name "wine." Made from a haphazard mix of grapes and other fruits crushed under less-than-ideal conditions (usually boots or crude shipboard presses), it’s a far cry from fine vintages. Yet, for many pirates, it’s better than risking bad water or enduring sobriety on a long voyage.
EffectsWhile its quality leave

items.name: Lizardfolk Signal Horn
items.description: Sounding a horn requires a DC 10 Perform (wind instruments) check and can convey concepts such as "Attack!", "Help!", "Advance!", "Retreat!", "Fire!", and, "Alarm!" The report of a signal horn can be clearly heard (Perception DC 0) up to a half-mile distant. For each quarter-mile beyond, Perception checks to hear the horn suffer a -1 penalty.

items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type S; Special -
Category Light; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Axes; Tribal
DescriptionThis one-handed axe is short (roughly 1 foot long) and designed for use with one hand. Unlike throwing axes, it is not well balanced for a graceful tumbling motion, and is instead heavier at its head. Tomahawks, war hatchets, and other such names usually re

items.name: Spear of the Mangrove Watch
items.description:
This is a spear grown, not forged, by the rangers of the Windward-Island lizardfolk. Its shaft is a single length of mangrove heartwood, reinforced with braided jungle vine and embedded bone rings. The leaflike blade is carved from magically hardened coral, adorned with a living jade sprout that always stays green. It pulses with the rhythm of the tides, guiding the ranger’s strikes like a living companion.
Forged from swamp tradition, ancestral magic, and salt-wind reverence, this weapon is mor

items.name: Tools, Thieves'
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 77, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price  30 gp (common),  100 gp (masterwork); Weight 1 lb. (common), 2 lbs. (masterwork)
DescriptionThis kit contains lockpicks and other tools you need to use the Disable Device skill. Without these tools, you must use improvised tools, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty on Disable Device checks.

 Masterwork Thieves' Tools: This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on Disable Devic

items.name: Soap
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 1 cp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionMost soap is made from animal fat and lye derived from ashes. You can use this thick block of soap to scrub clothes, pots, linens, adventurers, or anything else that might be dirty. A bar of soap has approximately 50 uses.

items.name: Cards
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 92
Price 1 sp–100 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Entertainment

Description
Playing cards range from block-printed symbols on thick paper to elaborate, hand-painted works of art on waxed vellum, ivory, wood, or even metal.

items.name: Tidebreaker Breastplate
items.description:
This breastplate is crafted to withstand the harsh conditions of the sea. A hallmark of the guards stationed at Tidewater Rock, it is adorned with intricate engravings of crashing waves and nautical emblems. It has been polished to a gleaming silver-blue sheen that captures ambient light, reflecting the shimmering depths of the ocean. The armor is renowned among sailors and marines for offering balanced protection while allowing flexibility in combat.
Aura: faint abjuration
Caster Level: 5
Requi

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.description: Nickel ore is a rare and prized mineral that can only be found deep within the earth.  It is said to be incredibly strong and durable, making it highly demanded metal by blacksmiths and craftsmen alike.

items.name: Potion of Haste
items.description:
The transmuted creatures move and act more quickly than normal. This extra speed has several effects.
When making a full attack action, a hasted creature may make one extra attack with one natural or manufactured weapon. The attack is made using the creature's full base attack bonus, plus any modifiers appropriate to the situation. (This effect is not cumulative with similar effects, such as that provided by a speed weapon, nor does it actually grant an extra action, so you can't use it to cast

items.name: Golden Encrusted Goblet
items.description: Throughout history and in certain fringe regions of the realms, goblets served as a symbol of status and refinement. Alchemists and herbalists have long warned against drinking alcohol from gold goblets, as the metal can react with the contents and produce toxic effects. Today, such goblets are most often discovered in forgotten tombs or among the hoards of exotic collectors, winged or otherwise.

items.name: Ruby Spinel
items.description: They say, if you ingest these, although, I wouldn't recommend it one bit, you can remember spells. Now I wonder, how can someone forget? Spinel is a rare mineral, and due to it, used to substitute even rarer ones like rubies. The blue variant is one of the most expensive gemstones on the market.

items.name: +1 Arrow
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143

Statistics
Cost 1 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description
An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier x2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.

items.name: Caydenbrew Teenie-Keg
items.description:
"One swig, one blessing, one tale to tell—or forget."

Caydenbrew Teenie-Kegs are single-serving wooden kegs of Cayden Cailean’s iconic brew, blessed in his name and crafted for adventurers, rogues, and pirates who seek fortune, bravery, and maybe just a bit of luck. Compact and practical, they’re a common sight among the devout—or those who just like to party.

Lore
Brewed with Blessings: Caydenbrew Teenie-Kegs are said to contain a drop of water from Cayden Cailean’s legendary Everlasting Tank

items.name: Milk
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 5 cp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionMilk is a nutritious liquid created by mammals, in particular cows, goats, sheep, and horses. Fresh milk is thick and tends to separate. Often, the cream is allowed to rise to the top and then skimmed off, with the remainder served as a beverage.

items.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply spell resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.

items.name: Yogurt
items.description:
YogurtSource Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price  1 sp; Weight  1/2 lb.
Category Food/DrinkDescriptionThis thick, fermented milk has a tangier taste than unprocessed milk. It may be sweetened with fruit, honey, or jam; blended with chopped herbs and oil to create a sauce; or mixed with water and salt, sugar, fruit, or mint as a drink.

items.name: Banded Mail
items.description: Banded mail is made up of overlapping strips of metal, fastened to a sturdy backing of leather and chain. The size of the metal plates, interconnected metal bands, and layers of underlying armor make it a more significant defense than similar armors, like scale mail or splint mail.

items.name: Booger
items.description: This prestigious vintage from the Konzdervoltz Estate—nestled in the limestone-rich hills outside Oppara—is known for its absurdly nasal pronunciation, its deeply complex notes of plums, cedar, and crushed violet, and its power to simultaneously elevate conversation and start duels. While outsiders might snicker at the name, among Taldan nobles, a bottle of Booger is a status symbol. No gala, diplomatic gathering, or high-stakes trade negotiation is considered truly respectable unless Booger is

items.name: Candle
items.description:
Candle
A candle dimly illuminates a small area, increasing the light level in a 5-foot radius by one step (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A candle cannot increase the light level above normal light. A candle burns for 1 hour. Price 1 cp; Weight -

Candle, Helmet This device consists of a helmet with a short, thin spike on top upon which a candle is stuck, freeing your hands for other tasks. Price 2 gp; Weight 4 lbs.

Candle Lamp A candle lamp is a small lantern-l

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: A breastplate protects a wearer’s torso with a single piece of sculpted metal, similar to the core piece of a suit of full plate. Despite its sturdiness, its inflexibility and open back make it inferior to complete suits of metal armor, but still an improvement over most non-metal armors.

items.name: Masterwork Arrow
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143

Statistics
Cost 1 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier x2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.

items.name: Scroll of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

items.name: Brow Brew
items.description:
Brow Brew is an oddity of beers, being produced primarily from grapes harvested from the vineyard of the Numerian town of Iadenveigh. The tough grapes are practically inedible, but are fermented with a particular yeast, grain and wood mushrooms to make a distinctive and rough beer considered an 'acquired taste' by visitors to the town.

items.name: Tidewater Rock Longbow
items.description: The Tidwater Rock Standard Issue Composite Longbow is a finely crafted masterwork weapon, renowned for its role among the elite guards of the Tidwater Rock coastal fortress. This longbow is expertly designed to harness the strength of its wielder, crafted by skilled artisans from the heart of the Tidwater Rock region. Each bow bears intricate etchings along its shaft, depicting waves and nautical motifs, reflecting its origin. Guardians of the fortress favor these bows for their exquisite balanc

items.description:

Price 1 sp; Weight -
Category Entertainment

Description
Dice can come in many shapes, but the most common are cubes.

items.name: Corsair's Coat
items.description:
The Corsair’s Coat is a stylish, weathered leather coat designed for swashbucklers and those who live by the sea. Light enough to move freely in battle, this coat is reinforced with hidden strips of flexible metal, offering protection without restricting the wearer’s agility.
It functions as a mithral chain shirt +1
 +2 on acrobatics - comfortable yet maneuverable feel
+4 CMD - helping the wearer avoid many dangers of boarding

items.name: Verdant Fang Bow
items.description:
Fashioned from the twisted roots of an ancient mangrove tree that once stood at the heart of a sacred tidal grove, the Verdant Fang is a +1 composite shortbow used by the Windward-Isles lizardfolk druids. Living far from cities and ports, these jungle stalkers rely on cunning, survival instinct, and nature’s favor to protect their territory and feed their clans.
Vines still cling to the bow’s limbs, swaying as if alive, and the grip pulses faintly with primal energy when drawn under the canopy o

 A direct hit deals 1d6 points of fire damage. Every creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hi

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.name: Lizardfolk Leathers
items.description: Made from a variety of skins blended together. Best not to think about it.

items.name: Silver Goblet
items.description: Silver goblets, along with other pieces such as plates, platters, cutlery, and eating utensils, are ever-present in a noble household. These items are often commissioned in bulk, typically from a dedicated smithy or the local blacksmith. In most cases, the noble provides the silver ingots required for the commission, having full control over the final product.

items.name: Acid
items.description:
AcidSource Alchemy Manual pg. 30, Ultimate Equipment pg. 107, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 10 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Alchemical WeaponsDescriptionYou can throw a flask of acid as a splash weapon. Treat this attack as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. A direct hit deals 1d6 points of acid damage. Every creature within 5 feet of the point where the acid hits takes 1 point of acid damage from the splash.

items.name: Scroll of Summon Swarm
items.description: You summon a swarm of bats, rats, or spiders (your choice), which attacks all other creatures within its area. (You may summon the swarm so that it shares the area of other creatures.) If no living creatures are within its area, the swarm attacks or pursues the nearest creature as best it can. The caster has no control over its target or direction of travel.

items.name: Heavy Mace
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
StatisticsCost 12 gp Weight 8 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type B; Special -
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Simple
Weapon Groups Hammers
DescriptionA heavy mace has a larger head and a longer handle than a light mace.

items.name: Supple, A Wine By Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Calvin Carpenter's finest line of dry white wines, made from the finest potatoes from exclusive farms in Ravounel, has a name - Supple.
Enjoy a glass of premium and refined flavor.
Savor the taste and aroma of the rich, earthy notes in each bottle, expertly crafted from the finest ingredients. Raise a glass of Supple, the epitome of luxury and refinement.

items.name: Chelish Scout Chain Shirt
items.description:
The Chelish Scout Chain Shirt is a finely crafted piece of armor, renowned for its exquisite design and bronze sheen that catches the light with every movement. Fashioned in Cheliax, this chain shirt is not just a protective garment but a work of art, designed for those who blend into society with both style and function. It provides excellent protection while allowing for mobility, ideal for scouts exploring the dense forests and treacherous terrains of the region.
Aura: faint transmutation
Cas

items.name: Backpack
items.description: This leather knapsack has one large pocket that closes with a buckled strap and holds about 2 cubic feet of material. Some may have one or more smaller pockets on the sides.

DescriptionManacles can bind a Medium creature. A manacled creature can use the Escape Artist skill to slip free (DC 30, or DC 35 for masterwork manacles). Breaking the manacles requires a Strength check (DC 26, or DC 28 for masterwork manacles). Manacles have hardness 10 and 10 h

items.description:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 0, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142, Ultimate Equipment pg. 17

Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range 20 ft.; Type P; Special -
Category Ranged; Proficiency Simple
Weapon Groups Thrown
DescriptionThis thrown weapon is larger than an arrow and shorter than a javelin, with a weighted tip and a shorter range than a javelin. Most darts are wooden shafts with a thick metal point.

items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price  2 gp (gallon),  5 cp (mug); Weight 8 lbs. (gallon), 1/2 lb. (mug)
DescriptionThis alcoholic beverage is made by fermenting honey and water. It may be flavored with spices, fruit, or hops.

items.description:

A holy symbol focuses positive energy and is used by good clerics and paladins (or by neutral clerics who want to cast good spells or channel positive energy). Each religion has its own holy symbol. The material used to make the holy symbol has no effect on its powers, though a religion may

items.description:

Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical 18-20/x2; Range -; Type S; Special -

Weapon Groups Blades, Heavy
DescriptionThis short, curved sword is favored by seafarers for closequarters combat. It is treated as a scimitar for any effects that apply to scimitars.

items.name: Tiger Eye
items.description: One of the more common gemstones out there, used as a status symbol among commoners, as it comes in a combination of gold and black. Due to its high demand, depending on the region, it can be quite rare. In most superstitious groups the gemstone is assumed to repel undead and restless spirits.

items.name: Scroll of Scorching Ray
items.description: You blast your enemies with a searing beam of fire. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of fire damage. The rays may be fired at the same or different targets, but all rays must be aimed at targets within 30 feet of each other and fired simultaneously.

items.name: Light Crossbow (Underwater)
items.description:

Weapon Groups Crossbows

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Copper ore is commonly found in multiple veins alongside a variety of other metals. It is easily identified by its reddish-brown color. It serves as the foundation for multiple alloys, such as brass or bronze, and is also an important metal in coin minting in all regions. Arcane casters experiment with copper metal rods in enchanted devices, believing it enhances the flow of arcane energy.

items.name: Buckler
items.description: This small metal shield is worn strapped to your forearm. You can use a bow or crossbow without penalty while carrying it. You can also use your shield arm to wield a weapon (whether you are using an off-hand weapon or using your off hand to help wield a two-handed weapon), but you take a –1 penalty on attack rolls while doing so. This penalty stacks with those that may apply for fighting with your off hand and for fighting with two weapons. In any case, if you use a weapon in your off hand, you

items.name: Detonator
items.description: A tool highly favored by miners, its combination with gunpowder explosive facilitates the rapid creation of holes or tunnels to reach the more interesting metals beneath the ground. Nevertheless, due to the occasional instability of the explosions and the rare risk of shrapnel damaging mine supports, drills tend to be the preferred choice.

items.name: Tidewater Meat Stick
items.description:
A staple of the South Shackles, the Tidewater Meat Stick is both a beloved street food and a shockingly effective weapon. Crafted from tempered steel and loaded with expertly grilled cuts of fish, chicken, and lamb, this savory skewer is seasoned with tongue-numbing coastal spices said to ward off evil spirits—and Northerners with weak constitutions.
Favored by sailors, dockside duelists, and spicy-food fanatics, the Meat Stick serves as a handy fallback when dinner turns dangerous. Why forge a

items.name: Booch
items.description: This vibrant green tea-based kombucha is a local specialty from the Tidewater Rock fortress in the dangerous seas of the southern Shackles, near Windward Isle. Crafted by combining island herbs with fermented tea, Booch serves to fortify sailors and sentries alike. Its tangy taste has a revitalizing quality, making it a popular drink among those who stand watch through the long nights. Folk tales suggest that this drink's unique recipe was a gift from a benevolent sea spirit keen on improving a

items.name: Tanglefoot bag
items.description:
Tanglefoot bagSource Alchemy Manual pg. 31, Ultimate Equipment pg. 107, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 50 gp; Weight 4 lbs.
Category Alchemical WeaponsDescriptionA tanglefoot bag is a small sack filled with tar, resin, and other sticky substances. When you throw a tanglefoot bag at a creature (as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet), the bag comes apart and goo bursts out, entangling the target and then becoming tough and resilient upon exposure to air. An entangled creatur

items.name: Goldenwake Mead
items.description:
“Smooth seas on the evening, but a storm in the morning”
Goldenwake Mead is a staple in coastal taverns across the Shackles, brewed with golden honey, faint spices, and a hearty kick of alcohol. It's known for its warmth, easy drinkability, and surprising potency, making it a favorite among sailors and pirates alike. While mostly known for its pleasant effects, overindulging in this stout mead can leave even the hardiest drinker feeling slightly off-kilter.

items.name: Sea-Steel Blade
items.description:
Sea-Steel is a rare, magically hardened form of deep-sea coral that is nearly indistinguishable from polished steel, save for its faint iridescent sheen that shifts between blue-green and storm-gray under certain light. Found only in deep ocean trenches, it is harvested and shaped by sahuagin weapon forgers, who infuse it with abyssal salts and elemental water magic to make it as strong as steel.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

items.name: Buckler
items.description: This small metal shield is worn strapped to your forearm. You can use a bow or crossbow without penalty while carrying it. You can also use your shield arm to wield a weapon (whether you are using an off-hand weapon or using your off hand to help wield a two-handed weapon), but you take a –1 penalty on attack rolls while doing so. This penalty stacks with those that may apply for fighting with your off hand and for fighting with two weapons. In any case, if you use a weapon in your off hand, you

items.name: Gold Bangle
items.description: Gold Bangle is a bracelet crafted from pure gold, designed to symbolize the highest class of nobility and the pinnacle of societal status. Forged by skilled blacksmiths using precise molds, each piece is then handed over to renowned goldsmiths who meticulously finish it with ornate detailing. These bangles are typically priced highly, which makes them frequent targets for thieves and swindlers seeking to profit from their value.

items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
Price 1 sp; Weight 3 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis blanket or net is attached to strong ropes, allowing you to hang it from a heavy branch or two trees and sleep above the ground. Climbing into or out of a hammock is a full-round action. A successful DC 5 Dexterity check reduces this to a move action.

items.description:

This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} checks.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.name: Bullseye Rum
items.description:
“It hits you right in the center, just not in a good way.”
Bullseye Rum is the drink of choice for the truly desperate, the miserly, or those who simply value quantity over quality. Its dark amber hue suggests a richness it absolutely does not deliver. The label, featuring a dartboard and the motto "Bullseye," is both an ironic jab at the drink's questionable aftereffects and a promise of its unerring ability to ruin your stomach. Produced by dubious distilleries scattered across the Shackles, i

items.name: Hair Pin
items.description: A designer hairpin crafted with small gemstones to represent high status. It is made in such a way that, when it holds the hair, it exudes elegance and style, or to simply signal membership in the high noble class. These are primarily made by experienced jewelers and only on very high-priced commissions.

items.name: Club
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
StatisticsDamage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range 10 ft.; Type B

items.name: Red Sail Reserve
items.description:
"Them sails wasn't always red."

Red Sails Reserve is a bold, crimson wine known for its sharp, bracing flavor and faint smoky aftertaste, reminiscent of the fiery volcanic soil of Firegrass Island where its grapes are grown. The wine is a staple at Goatshead Port, where the iconic ship Red Courage protects the surrounding waters, ensuring safe trade and keeping smugglers and pirates in check.
Tavern keepers proudly display bottles of Red Sails Reserve, treating them as both a fine drink and a s

items.name: Bronze Fleet Cutlass
items.description:
Each Bronze Fleet Cutlass is a testament to the fleet’s ruthless efficiency and disregard for individuality. These weapons are forged from the scraps of defeated ships and prisoners’ shackles, resulting in a haphazard yet functional design. No two Bronze Fleet Cutlasses look the same, but they all reflect the grim legacy of the slave-trading fleet.
The blade is often jagged, with imperfections that hint at its brutal origins, while the hilt may feature chains, manacles, or other relics of captiv

items.name: Tidewater Cutlass
items.description: The masterwork cutlass issued to the guards at Tidewater Rock in the Shackles is a finely crafted weapon, reflecting both the pride of the island's defenders and the treacherous seas surrounding it. Fashioned from polished steel with a sweeping guard engraved with nautical motifs, this cutlass is as much a symbol of status among the guards as it is a tool of their trade. Officers receive these weapons upon completing their training, and each blade bears the mark of the shipwrights who forged the

items.name: Potion of Barkskin
items.description:
Barkskin toughens a creature's skin. The effect grants a +2 enhancement bonus to the creature's existing natural armor bonus. This enhancement bonus increases by 1 for every three caster levels above 3rd, to a maximum of +5 at 12th level.
The enhancement bonus provided by barkskin stacks with the target's natural armor bonus, but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor. A creature without natural armor has an effective natural armor bonus of +0.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: It is said the first Amethyst was a young and beautiful priestess, however, two goddesses fought over her allegiance and unfortunately destroyed her. As the goddesses mourned and wept their loss, their tears combined and created the gem as it fell to the ground. I'm not certain if this tale holds any truth, as I have also heard that a glance and wine were involved.  Amethyst is a very common mineral and is found throughout the realms. It has a beautiful color and is faceted into jewelry cuts, ma

items.name: Chelish Crown
items.description: Defacing the crown (scratching off Abrogail’s face, carving holy symbols into it) is a high crime in Cheliax, punishable by branding, imprisonment, or execution.

items.name: Garden Hoe
items.description: The garden hoe serves multiple purposes, assisting with seeding by creating small trenches for seed placement and aiding in weed removal. With its sharp and wide blade, farmers favor the garden hoe for cutting rows of weeds. It effortlessly slides just beneath the soil's surface, cutting the roots of pesky weeds.
